name: Japan Foods Holding Ltd.
summary: Japan Foods Holding Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, oversees a significant portfolio of Japanese dining establishments throughout Singapore. The company's extensive brand lineup includes both its own proprietary restaurant concepts, such as Tokyo Shokudo, Yakiniku Shokudo, Fruit Paradise, Milan shokudo, Godaime, Romana Pizza and Pasta, Milan Tei, Milan Cafeteria, Kyo Komachi, and Katsuyoshi, as well as a diverse collection of franchised names like Ajisen Ramen, Konjiki Hototogisu, Maze Soba Hototogisu, Menya Musashi, Tori Sanwa, Osaka Ohsho, Kageyama, Afuri Ramen, Yonehachi, Menzo Butao, New ManLee Bak Kut Teh, Kumachan Onsen, Tororitenshi no WARABI-MOCHI, and Yamaya Kitchen. This enterprise, which commenced operations in 1997, has its headquarters located in Singapore.
